Co-Optimization of Grid Assets Simultaneous Planning: Traditionally, planning for power supply, network transmission, and storage occurred as separate processes. Instead of planning power plants, transmission lines, and battery systems separately, LLNL’s grid modeling software is an integrated model that evaluates all options at once. This holistic view can defer expensive upgrades by using storage strategically and ensuring that renewable assets are fully utilized. Direct Benefits: For a data center, this translates into improved reliability in the local energy market and more predictable, lower energy procurement costs over time. 2. Livermore researchers expect these lattice heat exchangers to reduce energy requirements of cooling systems by 20% and space needs by 50%. This can translate into meaningful annual savings for a data center’s bottom line and increase the physical space for server capacity. LLNL currently hold patents on triply periodic minimal surface structures used to develop these unique heat exchangers [21] [22]. This technology is being developed to replace currently used plate heat exchangers used in data centers. Researchers are currently applying for grants to scale up this technology.
